faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: It depends on the problem. Acne usually needs 4–6 peels. Pigmentation takes 4–8 sessions. Laser hair removal needs 6–8 sessions spaced 4–6 weeks. Your doctor gives you a number at the first consultation.

faqs.q: Is it safe for dark Indian skin?
faqs.a: Yes. We choose peels and laser settings for Fitzpatrick IV–V skin — the safest approach for Indian skin tones.
No. These treatments are designed to heal the skin. When a mole or wart is removed, we take extra care to minimise marks.
Light peels flake for 2–3 days. Medium peels need 3–5 days of heal time. Laser hair removal has no downtime.
Pigmentation starts fading in 4–8 weeks. Hair gets thicker in 3–6 months with PRP. Your doctor sets a realistic timeline at the start.

faqs.q: Can I wear makeup after a peel?
faqs.a: Wait 24 hours after light peels. We give written after-care with everything you need to know.
It gives long-term reduction — most patients see 70–90% less hair after a full course. A yearly touch-up keeps it that way.

faqs.q: What if my hair loss is genetic?
faqs.a: Genetic hair loss is managed with medicines like minoxidil and finasteride, plus PRP. We test first, then treat the cause.
